metas.name: Kalki 2898-AD
metas.description: In the year 2898 AD, around 6000 years after Kurukshetra war, Ashwatthama gears up for his final battle of redemption at the sign of hope in a dystopian world and Bhairava, a wisecracking and self-interested bounty hunter, tired of the perilous life becomes the hurdle in the process.

metas.name: Hanu-Man
metas.description: In a small village, Hanumanthu, a petty thief, finds a mysterious gem, that gives him god-like powers. Will he succeed in keeping these powers from falling into the wrong hands and save his village?

metas.name: Yashoda
metas.description: Looking to save her sister, Yashoda, a desperate woman agrees to be a surrogate and move in to a plush facility - but nothing is as it seems. In the world outside Eva, a Hollywood starlet dies under mysterious circumstances, so do a tycoon and a super model. An unknown drug seem to hold the key to the whole mystery.

metas.name: iSmart Shankar
metas.description: A contract killer goes on the run after eliminating a target and eventually finds himself linked to a slain cop whose memory is transferred to his brain.

metas.name: Aditya 369
metas.description: In a series of events involving a stolen diamond, Krishna and Hema get caught in a time machine and travel through the centuries, encountering historical figures and exploring futuristic worlds.

metas.name: Disco Raja
metas.description: Found frozen and brain-dead in Ladakh, Vasu is brought back to life but with no memories of who he was, until he starts to regain his past and piece it together to find the people responsible for his murder.

metas.name: Gaami
metas.description: Shankar is a wounded, reluctant and reclusive aghora on a quest to find the cure for his very rare human condition – the one that will be cured, only when he can confront and conquers the haunting ironical questions of his life.

metas.name: Aarambham
metas.description: Prisoner No. 299 is on death row at Kalaghati Jail. One night, just before his execution, he vanishes from his cell. Chaitanya and Madhav are the detectives assigned to the case, and with no clues other than a diary written by Miguel, they must solve the mystery and find out where Miguel went.

metas.name: Burra Katha
metas.description: Abhiram  is a man born with two brains – splitting into the massy Abhi and classy Ram whenever triggered by loud noises. How he copes with it forms the crux of the story.

metas.name: A (Ad Infinitum)
metas.description: Sanjeev cannot recollect his past but keeps dreaming of it. But what he ends up finding out is much more than what he bargained for.

metas.name: Dorikithe Dongalu
metas.description: Nandan, son of a police officer, and Madhavi, daughter of a wronged scientist, join forces to uproot anti-social elements.

metas.name: Nenu Leni Na Premakatha
metas.description: Love can be timeless and boundless. Story revolves around a true love blossoming between 2 sweet adorable persons belonging from two different timelines (1983 and 2020), a HAM Radio acting as fate connecting them to fulfill their destiny.

metas.name: Play Back
metas.description: Karthik is an investigative crime reporter from 2019, while Sujatha is from 1993 . An accidental cross time phone talk connects them. When Karthik knows about her difficulties, he tries to change her future by changing the incidents from her past.

metas.name: Ram Asur
metas.description: Ram tries to make a synthetic diamond but fails most of the time, leading to scars in his relationship with Priya.  Through a friend, Ram meets priest called Ramachari, who in turn asks Ram to meet Suri. Ram’s life changes after meeting Suri.

metas.name: Antariksham 9000 KMPH
metas.description: The coordinates of an old satellite from India, Mihira, are lost with the potential for it to wreak havoc with communications worldwide. Astronaut Dev’s life was turned upside down five years ago and he now teaches science at a government school. He’s brought in to fix the satellite but is that the only reason he agrees to come back?

metas.name: WWW
metas.description: WWW revolves around four friends from different cities working together in a software support company, who face online threats.

metas.name: 7:11 PM
metas.description: An incident that takes place at 7:11 PM changes the fate of a town called Hamsala Deevi and a planet called Proxima-EV12. Ravi, An IPS aspirant travels beyond imagination through time to stop a criminal mastermind, save his loved ones and his beloved town.

metas.name: Bombhaat
metas.description: Vicky is a man who’s brought up being told by his parents he’s the unluckiest fellow on earth. His girlfriend Chaitra  goes against the world and even her own father to prove him wrong. Life goes for a toss, more than usual, when he rescues his mentor’s daughter Maya.

metas.name: Beach Road Chetan
metas.description: When a happy-go-lucky kind of a guy chances upon a mysterious iPhone, his life turns topsy-turvy to unexpected consequences.

metas.name: Not All Movies Are the Same: Dual
metas.description: After losing everything to a personal mistake, a young man stumbles into a parallel world where a family is trapped by zombies. Driven to save them, he must navigate this deadly reality and fight for survival-and redemption
